intro.text: A Purelaker village out on the Purelake, the only one for miles around.

description.text: Its houses stand on stilts that lift them only partway, so a few inches of water cover the floors, and their domed roofs make them look like rockbuds. Maib's house is near the middle of the village. A rare fish, the kolgril, lives nearby.

items.text: At Maib's house, Ishikk told a group of foreigners that Hoid had not been around.
